# PLANS Architecture, PLLC: NYC DOB permits

> Licensed architects in Brooklyn who file NYC Department of Buildings permits at volume: apartment renovations (Alt-2), Alt-COs and new Certificates of Occupancy, legalizations and violations, and commercial fit-outs. 117 DOB filings at 64 addresses since 2017. Typical DOB approval on an apartment renovation: 14 days after filing (median of 31 filings).

- Starting prices: DOB filing, general construction, from $5,000; plumbing filing added on, $3,000; energy code filing added on, $2,000; legalization records and feasibility study, $5,000; professional certification for commercial tenants, $5,000.
- Every quote follows a free check of the building's DOB, HPD and zoning records.
- Owners and tenants sign and pay PLANS directly; designers and contractors refer projects.
- Office: 276 Greenpoint Avenue, 2nd Fl., Brooklyn, NY 11222.
- Start a project: https://permits.plans.nyc/#start
